text.tspan: Income or consumption share of the richest decile 1963 to 2024
Share of income or consumption received by the richest decile (tenth of the population). The chart shows breaks
in the comparability of the underlying household survey data over time within each country individually.

tspan.tspan: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2026)
Depending on the country and year, the data relates to income (measured after taxes and benefits) or to consumption, per capita.
